problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A$, where

$$
f(x,y)={\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡y,\, & \text{if}\,-1<x<1,\,0<y<\pi , \\ x\operatorname{sin}⁡y,\, & \text{if}\,1<x<2,\,0<y<\pi ,\end{aligned}
$$

and  $R$ is the domain of $f.$

$$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, notice that the rectangle $R$ can be represented as a union of two smaller rectangles, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}R & =((-1,0)\cup (0,2))\times (1,3) \\  & =((-1,0)\times (1,3))\cup ((0,2)\times (1,3)).\end{aligned}
$$

So, we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{(-1,0)\times (1,3)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(0,2)\times (1,3)}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{(-1,0)\times (1,3)}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2})\,\text{d}A+{∬}_{(0,2)\times (1,3)}2\sqrt{xy}\,\text{d}A.\end{aligned}
$$
